# Unstop

> Unstop is a comprehensive platform connecting students and professionals with competitions, hackathons, scholarships, internships, and skill-building opportunities from leading global organizations.

Unstop aggregates opportunities from major corporations like Procter & Gamble, Accenture, Reliance Industries, and WorldQuant, while also offering educational resources and simulations through its LearnBiz platform. The site serves as a central hub for career development, technical learning, and competitive engagement.

## Key Topics

- Competitions
- Hackathons
- Scholarships
- Internships
- SQL
- Database
- Technical Skills
- Career Development
- Business Simulations
- Networking
- Accenture
- Procter & Gamble
- Reliance Industries
- WorldQuant
- IIMA Ventures

## Core Platform

- [Unstop Homepage](https://unstop.com/): Main platform hub for competitions, hackathons, scholarships, and internships for students and corporates
- [LearnBiz Simulations](https://simulations.unstop.com/): Business and economics learning platform offering interactive simulations and experiential learning

## Technical Learning & Guides

- [SQL Query: Complete Guide with Types, Syntax And Examples](https://unstop.com/blog/sql-query): Comprehensive SQL query tutorial covering syntax, types, and practical examples for database learners
- [What Is A CISCO Packet Tracer? Features, Applications, Benefits](https://unstop.com/blog/cisco-packet-tracer): Guide to Cisco Packet Tracer networking simulation tool with features, applications, and benefits

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://unstop.com/legal/privacy-policy): Legal privacy policy and terms of service for the Unstop platform
